# Linux Foundation Training and Certification

> The Linux Foundation's comprehensive platform for open source training, certifications, and skill development across cloud, containers, systems, security, and emerging technologies.

Linux Foundation Training provides professional certifications, e-learning courses, and micro-credentials through the THRIVE-ONE subscription model. The platform covers critical technology domains including Kubernetes, DevOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and Linux system administration, serving IT professionals, developers, and enterprise teams.

## Key Topics

- Kubernetes
- Certifications
- Linux Foundation
- THRIVE-ONE Subscriptions
- SkillCreds
- DevOps
- Cloud & Containers
- Cybersecurity
- System Administration
- Kubestronaut
- IT Professional Development
- AI & Machine Learning
- Linux Certifications
- Emerging Technologies
- Kubernetes Security

## Core Learning Paths & Subscriptions

- [Open Source Training | Linux Foundation Training and Certification](https://training.linuxfoundation.org): Linux Foundation's main training hub offering certifications, courses in Kubernetes, Rust, PyTorch and more.
- [Subscriptions - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/subscriptions): THRIVE-ONE subscription plans providing unlimited access to 65+ e-learning courses and SkillCreds.
- [IT Professional Programs - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/itprofessionalprogram-catalog): Tailored IT Professional Programs for Cloud Engineer, DevOps, and Cloud Native Developer roles.
- [SkillCreds - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/skillcred): SkillCreds micro-credentials covering technical skills in DevOps, shell scripting, and data formats.

## Certifications & Credentials

- [Certifications - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/certification-catalog): Catalog of Linux Foundation certifications including LFCA, LFCS, CKA, and CKAD credentials.
- [Technology Catalog - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/technology-catalog): Technology Catalog featuring Linux certifications, system administration, and Kubernetes training paths.

## Cloud, Containers & DevOps

- [Cloud & Containers - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/cloud-containers): Kubernetes certification training including CKA, CKAD, and Kubestronaut program certifications.
- [System Administration - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/system-administration): Linux system administration courses and LFCS certification for IT career entry and advancement.
- [Cybersecurity - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity training including Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist and Kubestronaut certifications.

## Specialized Technologies

- [AI & ML - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/ai-machine-learning): AI and Machine Learning courses covering PyTorch, Kubeflow, and conversational AI topics.
- [Linux Kernel Development - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/linux-kernel-development): Linux kernel development training covering device drivers, embedded systems, and eBPF.
- [Networking - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/networking): Networking training covering 5G, cloud-native, eBPF observability, and Nephio projects.
- [Blockchain & Decentralized Identity - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/blockchain-decentralized-identity): Blockchain and decentralized identity training with Hyperledger Fabric and Besu certifications.
- [IoT & Embedded Development - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/embedded-development): IoT and embedded development training including RISC-V certification and hardware development.
- [Web & Application Development - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/application-development): Web and application development courses including WebAssembly and FDC3 standard training.

## Emerging Technologies & Advanced Topics

- [Emerging Technologies - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/emerging-technologies): Emerging technologies training in AI/ML, DevOps tools, and data formats for all skill levels.
- [Systems Engineering - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/systems-engineering): Systems engineering training with RISC-V Foundational Associate certification for IT infrastructure.

## Leadership & Strategy

- [Executive Education - Linux Foundation - Education](https://training.linuxfoundation.org/about/executive-education): LF Executive Education offering cybersecurity strategy and AI strategy courses for C-suite leaders.
